title: Red Bird MPhil Program (2027 Fall intake)
institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), College of Future Technology

compensation.value: Postgraduate Studentship of CNY 120,000 per year for up to 24 months
compensation.evidence_quote: a stipend of CNY 120,000 per year for up to 24 months for full-time MPhil students

about: Interdisciplinary research MPhil at HKUST (Guangzhou) for Fall 2027. Applications close 1 March 2027 (23:59); full-time students are automatically considered for a CNY 120,000-per-year studentship for up to 24 months. Tuition is CNY 60,000 per year.
requirements: Select 'Master of Philosophy (General)' in the Online Admission System; no hub or thrust needed
All full-time MPhil students automatically considered for the Postgraduate Studentship
Applications after the deadline roll over to the 2028 Fall intake

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
why: Skills: "Research" → Objective: "Compare sources, viewpoints, approaches, products, or alternatives using explicit criteria and structured analytical frameworks."
Field: "Interdisciplinary research (MPhil)" → Objective: "Use AI to explore, organize, and structure information collected from multiple documents or professional sources."
